rangeKm.note: Subaru AU MY27 spec: 'Electric driving range (WLTP) (km)' 533 on 18-inch wheels. EV Database e-Outback TEL/TEH 526/477 km: AU figure sits 1-2% above the EU band, within homologation variation, not an NEDC-scale gap

consumptionKwhPer100km.note: 154 Wh/km WLTP combined; EV Database rated 153 (TEL) Wh/km; 71/533 = 13.3 implied (plug-to-wheel loss)

towKg.note: Subaru AU spec: with trailer brakes (max) 1500, without 750, ball load 150
